{{Spoiler}} {{Stub|Please contribute more images to fix the remaining missing thumbnails for each area.}} {{Location Infobox |title = Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou |image = Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.png |type = Region |map = Solaris-3 |nation = Huanglong }} {{Intro/Location|Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou}} It is a central junction located within the Manifold Sanctum of [[Xuanfang Hold]], and is home to many [[Celestial]]s who serve [[Hsin]] throughout the region, along with [[Suhsin]]. The Nexus connects to a myriad of fractal Heart Realms and Inner Threshold pocket dimensions, many of which are direct reflections of Hsin's memories of [[Mengzhou]]. The region is administrated by the Nexus Fox Shadow, a towering mountain-sized simulacra of Hsin that is visible from everywhere in the Simulacrum Nexus, created by the Sentinel to regulate the region. ==Areas== {| class="article-table alternating-colors-table tdc1" style="width: 100%;" ! style="width: 200px;" |Name !
